answer: Trust propagates through bounded-length random walks on an attestation graph, so influence reflects independently supported paths rather than raw identities. A sybil cluster may add internal edges, but few links to honest nodes create a sparse external cut and low conductance, measured against the smaller side’s volume. With capped transition weights and a fixed walk horizon, this bottleneck limits the cluster’s reachable voting mass; names such as dune, violet, and nadir confer no weight.
